info.title: orch dashboard API
info.description: The API behind the orch dashboard. Reads are cheap; writes go through `dispatch.ts`, the only writer of orch state.

ok.description: Always true when the server answers.

home.description: The orch state directory the server reads.

generated_at.description: When this list was built, ISO 8601 UTC.

kind.description: loop repeats a prompt; watch runs a monitor command.

status.description: lost means the recorded process no longer exists.

reason.description: Why it stopped, when it did.

interval.description: Seconds between ticks or reruns. 0 for a streaming monitor.

deadline.description: Epoch seconds when it stops by itself.

next.description: Loop: epoch seconds of the next tick.

last_exit.description: Loop: exit code of the last iteration.

skipped.description: Loop: ticks skipped because the session was busy.

when_idle.description: Loop: waits for an idle session before each tick.

last_event.description: Monitor: when the last event arrived.

chat_id.description: The chat this loop or monitor posts its results into, when it was started from a chat.

ActiveItemDto.description: A running loop or monitor, or one that failed or lost its process.

output.description: What `dispatch.ts` printed, when it printed anything.

error.description: What went wrong, in one sentence. Never a stack trace.

ErrorDto.description: Every failed request answers with this shape.

boot_at.description: When this server process started, ISO 8601 UTC.

boot_head.description: Git HEAD at startup; null when git was unavailable.

stale.description: HEAD moved since startup, or a source file is newer than the boot time. False when the check failed.

missing_commits.description: git log boot_head..HEAD, newest first, at most 20.

missing_total.description: How many commits boot_head..HEAD holds in all.

count.description: How many files are newer than the boot time.

changed_files.description: Source files newer than the boot time.

chats_streaming.description: Chats with a reply streaming now. A restart cuts them.

runs_running.description: Orch run nodes running now. A restart does not affect them; agents run outside the server.

error.description: Why the check failed, when it did; the dashboard then says the check is unavailable.

BuildInfoDto.description: Whether the running server includes the code on disk.

subject.description: First line of the commit message.

BuildCommitDto.description: A commit the running server does not include.

path.description: Path relative to the repository root.

BuildFileDto.description: A source file changed after the server started.

RestartRefusedDto.description: A restart that was refused, with the command to run by hand.

https_port.description: The HTTPS port; 0 when HTTPS is off.

https_listening.description: True when the HTTPS listener is answering.

https_url.description: Secure link for a device that needs a secure context (microphone, clipboard); null when HTTPS is not listening.

trust_path.description: Path of the page that explains how to trust the certificate; null when no local CA is in use.

cert_source.description: Certificate source: tailscale, mkcert, localca, selfsigned or files.

problem.description: Why HTTPS is not up, or null.

secure_link_hint.description: Whether the quiet secure-link hint may show (serve.json secure_link_hint).

ServerInfoDto.description: The optional HTTPS listener of this server. HTTP stays the default; nothing in orch uses this port by itself.

generated_at.description: When this list was built, ISO 8601 UTC.

description.description: What the schedule is for. Null or absent when none.

cron.description: Five-field cron expression or an @alias, in the machine's local time.

created_at.description: When it was created, ISO 8601 UTC.

updated_at.description: When it was last edited, ISO 8601 UTC. Absent until the first edit.

prompt.description: The prompt text, for a prompt schedule.

profile.description: The profile that runs the prompt.

model.description: Catalog model id the prompt runs on. Null or absent: the profile's default model.

command.description: The shell command, for a command schedule.

timeout.description: Seconds a command may run. 0 means the default limit (1 h).

next_at.description: Epoch seconds of the next run. Null when paused.

last_run_at.description: When it last started, ISO 8601 UTC.

last_status.description: Status of the newest run. Null when it never ran.

target.description: Set when the result returns to a chat.

timezone.description: IANA time zone of a chat schedule's cron.

pause_reason.description: Why a chat schedule paused itself.

ScheduleDto.description: A cron schedule that runs a prompt or a shell command.

started_at.description: When the run started, ISO 8601 UTC.

ended_at.description: When it ended, taken from its exit marker. Null while running.

kind.description: Whether this run was a prompt, a command or a prompt posted into a chat.

ref.description: A job id for a prompt run, a run directory for a command run.

status.description: running until an exit marker exists; lost when the process vanished without one.

exit.description: Exit code of a command run. Null for a prompt run or while running.

model.description: Catalog model id a prompt run used. Null or absent: the profile's default model.

message_id.description: Chat schedules: id of the message the run posted.

duration_ms.description: Chat schedules: how long the run took, in ms.

error.description: Chat schedules: why the run failed.

note.description: Chat schedules: a note, e.g. a missed run that was skipped.

description.description: What the schedule is for. Optional.

cron.description: Cron expression, e.g. `0 9 * * 1-5`. Check one with GET /api/schedules/preview.

profile.description: The profile that runs the prompt, for kind=prompt.

model.description: Catalog model id the prompt runs on, one the profile allows (GET /api/chat-options). Null or absent: the profile's default.

timeout.description: Time limit such as 30s, 5m or 1h, for kind=command.

ScheduleInputDto.description: A new schedule. A prompt schedule needs `prompt` and `profile`; a command schedule needs `command`.

next.description: Local time of the next run, `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM`.

SchedulePreviewDto.description: The next time a cron expression fires.

description.description: What the schedule is for. Empty clears it.

cron.description: Cron expression. Check one with GET /api/schedules/preview.

kind.description: What each run does. Omit to keep the current kind.

profile.description: The profile that runs the prompt, for kind=prompt.

model.description: Catalog model id for kind=prompt. Null goes back to the profile's default; omitted keeps it (a profile change drops a model the new profile does not allow).

workdir.description: Working directory, for kind=command. Empty clears it.

timeout.description: Time limit such as 30s, 5m or 1h, for kind=command. 0 means the default (1 h).

ScheduleEditDto.description: A change to a schedule. Omitted fields stay as they are. `kind` switches between a prompt and a command schedule and clears the other kind's fields; a switch needs the new kind's fields. An empty `workdir` and a `timeout` of 0 clear those.

text.description: The last 64 KB of the run's output.

generated_at.description: When this list was built, ISO 8601 UTC.

runs.description: Run summaries: id, title, status (running, done, error, cancelled, covered), node counts, times. A covered run (its unfinished work was copied into another run) also has covered_by (run id), covered_note, covered_nodes (carried node ids) and covered_map (oldNode to newNode).

generated_at.description: When this was built, ISO 8601 UTC.

run.description: The run's state.json, see references/state-and-config.md. status is one of running, done, error, cancelled, covered; covered adds covered_by, covered_at, covered_note, covered_nodes, covered_map.

RunEnvelopeDto.description: One run with its plan and every node.

events.description: Events {n, at, kind, node, from, to, note, by}, oldest first, at most 200 (the newest).

next.description: Cursor for the next call: the number of the newest event.

messages.description: Messages {id, role, time, parts[{kind, text, tool?}]}, oldest first.

next.description: Cursor for `after`: the newest message id.

messages.description: Messages {id, seq, from, to, kind (tell|ask|answer|rule), at, text, status, delivered_at, via, answer?, answered_at?, reply_to?}.

socket_path.description: Herdr socket path of the candidate.

RepointInputDto.description: The coordinator pane the user picked from the candidates.

ask.description: Answer only: the ask id (e.g. `m3`). Default: the node's oldest open ask.

NodeMessageInputDto.description: A message from the user to one node.

generated_at.description: When this was built, ISO 8601 UTC.

text.description: The tail of the job's log.

generated_at.description: When this answer was built, ISO 8601 UTC.

no_report.description: Nodes whose owner ended without a report.

needs_user.description: Waiting nodes blocked on the user.

ready.description: Nodes ready to start in runs with a free slot.

flagged_runs.description: Running runs with at least one node that is not ok.

state.description: `ok`; `degraded`: up, but its herdr web registry file is missing or wrong, or herdr web does not list it; `down`: the instance does not answer; `off`: herdr is disabled.

enabled.description: Whether orch runs jobs in herdr at all.

reason.description: Why herdr is on or off.

pid.description: The server pid from its pidfile.

pid_alive.description: The pidfile's process is a live herdr.

socket_ok.description: The instance answers on its socket.

registry.description: The herdr web registry file: `ok`, `missing` or `wrong`.

web_url.description: The herdr web plugin URL that was asked.

nudged.description: This check re-ensured the instance or its registry.

at.description: When the check ran, ISO 8601 UTC.

herdr.description: The orch herdr instance's latest check; null before the first one.

HealthSummaryDto.description: Node-health counts over the running runs, from the server's in-memory checks.

generated_at.description: When this answer was built, ISO 8601 UTC.

source.description: `monitor`: read from the run's `health:<id>` monitor; `watcher`: the server's own pass; `none`: no result yet.

at.description: When the check ran, ISO 8601 UTC.

ready.description: Waiting nodes whose dependencies are done, ready to start.

changes.description: What changed since the previous check.

health.description: The check, null until one has succeeded.

`stalled`: no activity for the stale limit; `unowned`: no owner recorded; `dead`: the owner is gone; `no-report`: the owner ended without reporting; `needs-user`: a waiting node blocked on the user; `held`: a waiting node the coordinator holds back (`node update --hold`).

owner_id.description: The owning session or job id, null when there is none.

generated_at.description: When the answer was built, ISO 8601 UTC.

requirements.description: One entry per requirement. `ok` is true for handled, superseded and waived.

RunRequirementsEnvelopeDto.description: A run's requirements ledger, with the state of every linked node.

generated_at.description: When this answer was built, ISO 8601 UTC.

state.description: `on`: the watchdog runs in this server; `off`: it was not started.

started_at.description: When the watchdog started, ISO 8601 UTC.

flags.description: Open flags on running runs: stalled nodes and nodes out of retries.

WatchdogStatusDto.description: The server's watchdog: its state, newest actions first, per-run counters and open flags.

node.description: Node id; null for a run-level action.

rule.description: `lost`: the node's process or session was dead for 2 minutes; `stalled`: idle past stall_minutes; `unverified`: done without handoff.md; `infra-retry`: an infrastructure error; `finish`: every node is done.

action.description: The dispatch.ts call (`node retry`, `node update error`, `run finish`), or `flag` when the watchdog only reports.

rc.description: dispatch.ts exit code; null for a flag.

WatchdogActionDto.description: One watchdog action, as one line of `<home>/watchdog/actions.log`.

unverified.description: Done nodes re-queued for a missing handoff.

flagged.description: Nodes flagged after their one retry.

WatchdogFlagDto.description: A node the watchdog reports and does not act on.

document.description: The document. Validated on write, never on read.

OpaqueDocumentDto.description: A JSON document whose shape is documented in references/state-and-config.md.

probed_at.description: When they were probed, ISO 8601 UTC.

HarnessesEnvelopeDto.description: The harnesses on this machine. Cached for 20 s; `?refresh=1` skips the cache.

wired.description: True when orch can dispatch to it. False means only detected.

needs.description: What it needs to run, e.g. an API key.

usage.description: Where the harness may be used: `chat` and/or `runs`. Missing means both (settings.harness_usage).

available.description: True when the binary or endpoint was found.

reason.description: Why it is unavailable, empty when it is available.

HarnessDto.description: One harness orch knows of, and whether it can run.

usage.description: `chat` (chat page only), `runs` (orch runs, nodes, loops, schedules, planner only) or `both`.

UsageInputDto.description: Where a profile or harness may be used.

name.description: Skill name from the SKILL.md front matter.

description.description: Skill description from the front matter.

SkillDto.description: One skill the server can read.

status.description: Lifecycle: new, queued, working, done, wontfix.

result.description: Outcome note, set when the item is done or wontfix.

work_run.description: The run that works on it.

status.description: Lifecycle: new, queued, working, done, wontfix.

result.description: Outcome note, set when the item is done or wontfix.

work_run.description: The run that works on it.

run_id.description: Id of the run created for the batch, null when there was nothing to work on.

items.description: Ids of the items put into the run.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page. Null on the last page.

ProjectPageDto.description: A page of projects, newest first.

path.description: Absolute directory the project's chats run in. Null uses a scratch directory.

archived_at.description: When it was archived. Null while active. Projects are never deleted.

parent_id.description: The parent project of a sub project; null for a top-level project. Sub projects are one level deep.

ProjectDto.description: A project groups chats and gives them a working directory.

path.description: Absolute directory the chats run in. Must exist. For a sub project, omit it to use `<parent path>/<name>` (created when missing).

parent_id.description: Makes this a sub project of that top-level, active project. 404 when it does not exist; 400 when it is archived or is itself a sub project.

path.description: Absolute directory, or null to clear it.

ProjectUpdateDto.description: Fields of a project to change. Omitted fields stay as they are.

path.description: Absolute directory the project's chats run in. Null uses a scratch directory.

archived_at.description: When it was archived. Null while active. Projects are never deleted.

parent_id.description: The parent project of a sub project; null for a top-level project. Sub projects are one level deep.

path.description: Absolute path of an existing directory inside an allowed root (symlinks are resolved first), or null to clear it.

not_for_chat.description: Profiles left out of the pickers because their profile or harness is limited to orch runs, with the reason. A chat that already uses one keeps working; show the reason as a warning.

ChatOptionsDto.description: Everything the harness, profile and model pickers need.

available.description: Whether the harness's program is installed on this machine.

persistent.description: True when one live process serves a whole chat. False when each message starts a process and only resumes the session if the adapter can.

efforts.description: Effort levels the harness takes, lowest first. Empty: no effort control.

memory.description: How the chat remembers: one live process, the harness's own session resumed per message, or recent history replayed in the prompt.

enabled.description: False when the profile or its harness is disabled. Show it greyed out.

configured.description: False when an env var or auth variable the profile needs is not set.

problem.description: What is missing when `configured` is false.

models.description: Models the profile allows. One entry means the picker has no real choice.

slug.description: What is passed to the harness.

default.description: True for the profile's own model, used when `model_id` is null.

ModelOptionDto.description: A model a profile may use.

snippet.description: Text around the match, with matches wrapped in `[[` and `]]`.

SearchHitDto.description: A message that matches a search.

root.description: The folder that was listed. Empty when no root exists.

roots.description: The allowed roots (settings.chat_roots, existing ones only).

truncated.description: True when more than 200 folders exist and the list was cut.

FolderListDto.description: Child folders of a root. Recently used first, then by name; dot folders and node_modules are hidden; at most 200.

last_used_at.description: When a chat or project last picked it. Null when never.

FolderItemDto.description: A folder a chat may run in.

project_id.description: Project the chat belongs to, if any.

title.description: Title. Starts as `New chat`, then the first message, until renamed.

model_id.description: Catalog model id. Null means the profile's default model.

session_id.description: The agent's own session id, set after the first reply.

status.description: running while a reply streams; waiting while the agent's question waits for an answer (the queue does not start the next message then); else idle.

updated_at.description: Last activity, ISO 8601 UTC. The list is ordered by it.

archived_at.description: When it was archived. Chats are never deleted.

unread.description: 1 when a schedule, loop or monitor posted into the chat and it was not opened since.

title_manual.description: 1 once a person set the title. The first message never replaces such a title.

cwd.description: Absolute folder the agent runs in for this chat. Null means the project's folder, else a scratch folder.

subfolder.description: Relative folder inside the project's folder, normalised. When the chat has no folder of its own, the agent runs in `<project path>/<subfolder>`. Null means the project's folder.

effort.description: Effort asked of the harness. Null is Auto: nothing is passed.

effective_cwd.description: In chat reads and lists: the folder the next turn runs in (the chat's own, else its project's). Null means a scratch folder.

awaiting_answer.description: True while the agent asked a question that the user has not answered yet. Kept for older clients: `status` is `waiting` for the same chats.

empty.description: In chat lists only: true when the chat has no message and no attachment. Empty chats older than 24 hours are archived at server start.

warning.description: In single-chat responses: a visible problem, e.g. the project's directory no longer exists and the agent runs in a scratch folder.

subfolder.description: Subfolder of the project's folder. `null` or an empty string clears it. Same rules as on create.

ChatUpdateDto.description: Changes to a chat's own settings.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page. Null on the last page.

ChatPageDto.description: A page of chats, newest activity first.

project_id.description: Project the chat belongs to, if any.

title.description: Title. Starts as `New chat`, then the first message, until renamed.

model_id.description: Catalog model id. Null means the profile's default model.

session_id.description: The agent's own session id, set after the first reply.

status.description: running while a reply streams; waiting while the agent's question waits for an answer (the queue does not start the next message then); else idle.

updated_at.description: Last activity, ISO 8601 UTC. The list is ordered by it.

archived_at.description: When it was archived. Chats are never deleted.

unread.description: 1 when a schedule, loop or monitor posted into the chat and it was not opened since.

title_manual.description: 1 once a person set the title. The first message never replaces such a title.

cwd.description: Absolute folder the agent runs in for this chat. Null means the project's folder, else a scratch folder.

subfolder.description: Relative folder inside the project's folder, normalised. When the chat has no folder of its own, the agent runs in `<project path>/<subfolder>`. Null means the project's folder.

effort.description: Effort asked of the harness. Null is Auto: nothing is passed.

effective_cwd.description: In chat reads and lists: the folder the next turn runs in (the chat's own, else its project's). Null means a scratch folder.

awaiting_answer.description: True while the agent asked a question that the user has not answered yet. Kept for older clients: `status` is `waiting` for the same chats.

empty.description: In chat lists only: true when the chat has no message and no attachment. Empty chats older than 24 hours are archived at server start.

ChatDto.description: A chat with one agent. Its harness, profile and model are fixed once it has a message.

project_id.description: Project to put the chat in.

harness.description: Harness id. Not checked here: a disabled or missing harness is reported when a message is sent.

profile.description: Profile name; empty when no profile is usable yet.

model_id.description: Catalog model id from the profile's list. Omit for the profile's default.

cwd.description: Folder to run in. Same rules as PATCH /api/chats/{id}/folder. Omit to use the project's folder.

subfolder.description: Subfolder of the project's folder to run in (relative; no `..`, no leading `/` or `~`, at most 6 levels, names up to 200 characters). Created when missing. 400 `subfolder needs a project with a folder` without a project folder. Omit or empty for none.

effort.description: Effort. Omit or null for Auto. 400 when the harness has no effort control.

ChatInputDto.description: A new chat. Pick harness, profile and model from GET /api/chat-options.

project_id.description: Project id, or null to take the chat out of its project.

ChatProjectDto.description: The project to move a chat to.

model_id.description: Catalog model id, or null for the profile's default.

effort.description: Effort for the next turn; omit or null for Auto. 400 when the harness has no effort control.

ChatConfigDto.description: A new harness, profile and model for the next turn. Allowed between turns, not while a reply runs.

items.description: The messages, newest first. Reverse them to display.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for older messages. Null when there are none.

MessagePageDto.description: A page of messages, newest first.

role.description: Who wrote it. `tool` rows record a tool call the agent made.

content.description: Text. For a streaming message, what has arrived so far.

status.description: streaming until the reply ends; then done, error or stopped.

error.description: Why the reply failed, when status is error.

selected_effort.description: Effort the hub recorded for this reply (low, medium, high, max or a provider word). Null when unknown or the hub could not be asked.

selected_model.description: Model the hub recorded as selected for this reply. Null when unknown.

input_tokens.description: Input tokens of the reply, 0 when not reported.

output_tokens.description: Output tokens of the reply, 0 when not reported.

cost_usd.description: Cost in USD when the harness reports it.

context_truncated.description: Truthy when older history was left out of the prompt to fit the context. Stored rows carry 0 or 1, SSE carries a boolean.

warning.description: A visible problem with this reply, e.g. the session could not be resumed.

parts.description: Typed parts (text, reasoning, tool-call, todo, file, diff; see src/shared/chat-parts.ts). Null on rows stored before parts existed: render `content`.

activity.description: Only on a reply that is running: what the agent is doing (starting, thinking, writing, tool, waiting), since when, when it last sent anything, and the running tool. Also sent as the `activity` SSE event. Null when the reply is not running.

chat_id.description: The chat it was uploaded to.

message_id.description: The message it belongs to. Null until that message is sent.

mime.description: MIME type: sniffed for png, jpeg, webp and gif, else from the extension.

AttachmentDto.description: A file attached to a message.

user_message_id.description: Id of the stored user message. Null when the message was queued.

assistant_message_id.description: Id of the assistant message that is now streaming. Null when the message was queued.

queued.description: True when a reply was running and the message went into the chat's queue.

queue_id.description: Id of the queue item, `que-…`, when queued.

SendResultDto.description: The turn has started. Follow it on GET /api/chats/{id}/events.

content.description: The text. May be empty when attachments are given.

attachment_ids.description: Ids of files uploaded to this chat and not yet sent.

stopped.description: False when no reply was running.

items.description: One entry per file, in request order.

WaitingChatsDto.description: Chats that wait for an answer to a question.

user_message_id.description: The user message that carries the answer.

QuestionAnswerResultDto.description: The answer was delivered: the reply it starts is running.

answers.description: One list per question: the chosen option labels, or typed text when the question allows custom answers.

custom.description: Typed answer for a call with a single question; added to its `answers`.

dismiss.description: True to skip the question. The agent is told it was skipped.

QuestionAnswerDto.description: Answer to a question, or a dismissal. Send `answers` or `dismiss: true`, not both.

items.description: The running item (if any), then the queued ones.

paused.description: True when the queue does not start the next message by itself: after a failed or stopped reply, or a restart. POST /queue/resume starts it.

waiting_for_answer.description: True while the agent's question waits for the person: the next queued message does not start until it is answered or skipped (or sent now). Not a pause: it continues by itself.

QueueSnapshotDto.description: The queue of a chat: the running message first, then the waiting ones in order.

text.description: The message text. May be empty when attachments are given.

attachment_ids.description: Ids of the uploaded files that go with the message.

position.description: 1-based place among the waiting messages. 0 for the one that is running.

state.description: queued waits, running is the turn in progress, sent and cancelled are over (they are not listed).

edited_at.description: When a person last edited it. Null when never.

message_id.description: The user message it became once it started.

QueueItemDto.description: One message in a chat's queue.

text.description: The message text. May be empty when attachments are given.

attachment_ids.description: Ids of the uploaded files that go with the message.

position.description: 1-based place among the waiting messages. 0 for the one that is running.

state.description: queued waits, running is the turn in progress, sent and cancelled are over (they are not listed).

edited_at.description: When a person last edited it. Null when never.

message_id.description: The user message it became once it started.

QueueItemEnvelopeDto.description: A queue item after a change.

ids.description: Queue item ids in the wanted order. Queued messages left out keep their relative order after these.

QueueReorderDto.description: The new order of the queued messages.

attachment_ids.description: New list of attachment ids (replaces the old list).

QueueEditDto.description: Changes to a queued message. Allowed only while it is queued.

interrupted.description: True when a running reply was stopped to make room.

SecureLinkHintDto.description: Whether the quiet 'open the secure link' hint may show. Kept in serve.json.

ChatItemsDto.description: Items of one kind in a chat.

cron.description: Cron expression, read in `timezone`. At least 5 minutes between runs.

timezone.description: IANA time zone, default the machine's.

mode.description: message (default) continues this chat; fresh runs a new session and posts the answer here.

ChatSchedulePatchDto.description: A change to a chat schedule. Omitted fields stay as they are.

ChatItemLogDto.description: The last runs, iterations or triggers of one item.

every.description: Seconds between iterations (at least 10). `When done` is the minimum.

max.description: Stop after this many iterations. 0 or absent: no limit.

mode.description: message or fresh. Both post each iteration into the chat.

until_regex.description: Stop when an iteration's reply matches this regular expression.

until_text.description: Stop when this is true; the agent judges it.

max_runtime.description: Seconds the loop may run in all.

ChatLoopInputDto.description: A loop that repeats a prompt in this chat.

spec.description: What to watch: file/folder path, url, command, stream (a command's output), run id or git folder.

every.description: Seconds between checks. At least 10 for local checks, 60 for URLs.

debounce.description: Seconds during which more triggers fold into one message.

expires_in.description: Seconds until it ends by itself. Default 24 hours.

then.description: tell posts a message; act also runs this prompt in the chat.

ChatMonitorInputDto.description: A monitor that posts into this chat when something changes or matches.

path.description: Absolute path of the workspace directory (created on first use).

has_folder.description: Whether the chat has a folder, so the folder scope exists.

moved_from.description: Where this chat's earlier workspace stayed after the chat moved, or null.

memory_size.description: Size of MEMORY.md in bytes (0 when missing).

WorkspaceDto.description: A workspace: where it is and what it holds.

modified.description: Last change, ISO time, or null.

content.description: The whole file. Larger than 200 KB answers 413.
